text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — Alex Michael says a fake hostage scenario tricked Google's AI into recommending a cracked SolidWorks site. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6465)

2 — Anthropic says Claude Mythos enabled Claude inference on AMD MI355X GPUs in three days with almost no human help. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6466)

3 — DeepMind introduced AlphaGenome 2 to help explain how DNA changes affect disease in specific cells. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6467)

4 — Runway released Praxis-1, a robot-control model using video pretraining, with Apache 2.0 open weights. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6468)

5 — Pika says Seedance 2.5 now supports native 4K on Pika and its API Club. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6469)

6 — Arav Srinivas says a Fable 5.2 Teammate built a browser zombie shooter in hours using code rather than 3D assets. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6470)

7 — Andrew Curran reports ByteDance plans a personal AI agent this month and expects to reach the US frontier by 2029–2030. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6471)

8 — Google Labs introduced Tabletop for shared, customizable group-planning spaces, with a US waitlist for adults. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6472)

9 — Google launched Gemini Decisions API for closed-set multimodal choices at $0.10 per million input tokens, with free output tokens. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6473)

10 — Jason Dainter shared a music video described as 99% AI, crediting Claude, Midjourney, Minimax, Suno and DaVinci. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6474)

11 — YouArt says its desktop AI agent operates creative software, handles client feedback and routes clips to cheaper API providers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6475)

12 — Grok Bot announced AI teammates that collaborate in Slack and Teams and can join meetings. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6476)

13 — LMSYS reports SGLang megakernels raised Muse Spark Open decoding from 517 to 1,109 tokens per second on eight GB300 GPUs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6477)

14 — Microsoft announced Classroom, a standalone education hub arriving in 2027 alongside—not replacing—Teams for Education. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6478)

15 — Photonstorm shared a Pong clone made after asking Fable 5.2 to “go wild” creating a game. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6479)

16 — LuminaBench speculates, without verification, that Gemini Helix and Hydrogen correspond to Flash Lite and Flash tiers. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6480)

17 — TheStalwart cites an NYT report alleging Jensen Huang had a relationship with Nvidia's healthcare vice president. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6481)

18 — Andrew Curran cites a WSJ report claiming Nvidia's board is preparing to oust Huang and meet later that day. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6482)

19 — Dan Niles predicts Huang's departure but argues Nvidia's product pipeline and agentic AI demand could support its outlook. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6483)

20 — A post citing Bloomberg reports Nvidia is using an outside firm to identify Huang replacements and considering an interim CEO. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6484)

--Hermes.
